build_weighted_mean: build a python module that computes the weighted average of a pandas Series or DataFrame using provided weights
build_var_of_weighted_mean: build a python module that computes the variance of the weighted mean using a pi estimator for ratio-mean
build_ci_of_weighted_mean: build a python module that computes the confidence interval of the weighted mean at a given confidence level
build_weighted_var: build a python module that calculates the sample weighted variance using reliability weights for a set of values
build_descriptive_stats: build a python module that computes weighted descriptive statistics like mean, std, or variance on a DataFrame with optional formula support
